card.name: Linking words in lung cancer patient selection
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, of, non) in oncology patient-selection text, right after NSCLC or 'based on the presence'. The next words are usually a drug name or a gene mutation such as EGFR or ALK.

modes.label: After NSCLC
modes.description: The word 'with' or 'non' right after NSCLC or a lung cancer phrase, before a drug or mutation.
modes.example: First-Line Treatment of NSCLC<< with>> EGFR Exon 20 Insert

modes.label: After 'presence' or 'detection'
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'based on the presence' or 'detection', before a mutation name.
modes.example: Select patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC for treatment with DATROWAY based on the presence<< of>> epidermal growth factor receptor (EG

card.writes: It pushes toward brain and gene-like pieces such as EG, and away from the words cancer and tumor.
card.plain: It marks the small linking word in lung cancer drug labels just before a gene mutation or drug is named.
